notes.text: CSV exports must use ';' as delimiter, not ','; Finance opens these files in Excel with French locale where comma breaks columns.
notes.author: generated

notes.text: CSV export headers must be snake_case (e.g. invoice_id, customer_name), not Title Case with spaces like 'Invoice ID'.
notes.author: generated

notes.text: Invoice CSV dates must be YYYY-MM-DD in UTC via toISODate (e.g. 2026-03-31), not full ISO timestamps like 2026-03-14T16:40:00Z.
notes.author: generated

notes.text: Invoice CSV totals must be raw integer cents (e.g. 123450), not formatted strings like '€1,234.50' from formatMoney.
notes.author: generated

notes.text: New modules in src/exports/ must use named exports only (e.g. export function exportInvoicesCsv), not default exports.
